## Tailored Solutions for Different Market Needs

[Talk to a Fuel Cell Expert][44]

From 70kW-360kW net power, Ballard’s heavy-duty fuel cell modules offer flexible and reliable
solutions for your transportation and power generation needs.

Powered by Ballard’s unique proton-exchange membrane (PEM) fuel cell stacks, our modules are
designed to meet the mechanical, electrical, and environmental requirements of the most demanding
applications.

#### Buses

Fuel cell electric buses are the only zero-emission technology that can directly replace diesel bus
fleets, offering the same route flexibility, fast refueling, and uncompromised performance in
challenging climates and environments. Hydrogen, as a low-carbon fuel, provides a scalable and
efficient refueling solution for bus depots.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell Buses][45]

[Fuel Cell Buses]

#### Trucks

Fuel cell electric trucks provide fleet operators with the familiar experience of diesel power while
delivering the benefits of electrification: zero tailpipe emissions, low noise and vibration, long
range, quick refueling, and no compromise on payload, ensuring maximum vehicle utilization.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell Trucks][46]

[Fuel Cell Trucks]

#### Rail

Hydrogen-powered fuel cell trains offer a cost-effective, high-performance, zero-emission
alternative to diesel trains and costly track electrification, providing a pathway to
decarbonization of train fleets.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell Rail][47]

[Fuel Cell Rail]

#### Marine

As the marine sector faces stricter emission standards for vessels, Ballard’s hydrogen fuel cells
offer a highly scalable, flexible, and reliable power source, providing zero emissions and
long-range distributed power solutions with specific marine type approvals.

[Learn more about Marine Fuel Cells][48]

[Marine Fuel Cells]

#### Stationary Power Generation

In response to electric grid constraints, disruptions and permitting restrictions, PEM fuel cells
offer a sustainable, quiet solution for stationary power generation ranging from hundreds of
kilowatts to megawatts – where reliability, low maintenance, and ability to cycle rapidly are
needed.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell in Power Generation][49]

[Fuel Cell in Power Generation]

#### Off Road & Material Handling

Productivity is crucial for many off-road and material handling applications. Zero-emission, fuel
cell-powered equipment allows operators to achieve significant economic and environmental benefits,
enhancing both efficiency and sustainability. Fuel cells also provide a path to decarbonization of
super heavy-duty off-road vehicles.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell in Off Road & Material Handling][50]

[Fuel Cell in Off Road & Material Handling]

###### Promise

## Customer support, when and where you need it most

As much as we’re a technology company, we are, first and foremost, here for our customers. We work
hard to understand the challenges you face and anticipate your needs. From the design validation
phase to system integration and after-sales support, we’re your partner in success. *Here for Life™*

[Customer Support][51]

[Customer Support][Customer Support]

## Clean power for the future

*Here for Life™* is the central pillar of our purpose. It signifies our recognition that
zero-emission power is imperative and the global transition to clean and secure energy is underway.
We are ready to play a pivotal role as a trusted partner, supporting the critical decarbonization
and energy security efforts of our customers, governments, and local communities.

From 70kW-360kW net power, Ballard’s heavy-duty fuel cell modules offer flexible and reliable
solutions for your transportation and power generation needs.

Powered by Ballard’s unique proton-exchange membrane (PEM) fuel cell stacks, our modules are
designed to meet the mechanical, electrical, and environmental requirements of the most demanding
applications.

#### Buses

Fuel cell electric buses are the only zero-emission technology that can directly replace diesel bus
fleets, offering the same route flexibility, fast refueling, and uncompromised performance in
challenging climates and environments. Hydrogen, as a low-carbon fuel, provides a scalable and
efficient refueling solution for bus depots.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell Buses][45]

[Fuel Cell Buses]

#### Trucks

Fuel cell electric trucks provide fleet operators with the familiar experience of diesel power while
delivering the benefits of electrification: zero tailpipe emissions, low noise and vibration, long
range, quick refueling, and no compromise on payload, ensuring maximum vehicle utilization.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell Trucks][46]

[Fuel Cell Trucks]

#### Rail

Hydrogen-powered fuel cell trains offer a cost-effective, high-performance, zero-emission
alternative to diesel trains and costly track electrification, providing a pathway to
decarbonization of train fleets.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell Rail][47]

[Fuel Cell Rail]

#### Marine

As the marine sector faces stricter emission standards for vessels, Ballard’s hydrogen fuel cells
offer a highly scalable, flexible, and reliable power source, providing zero emissions and
long-range distributed power solutions with specific marine type approvals.

[Learn more about Marine Fuel Cells][48]

[Marine Fuel Cells]

#### Stationary Power Generation

In response to electric grid constraints, disruptions and permitting restrictions, PEM fuel cells
offer a sustainable, quiet solution for stationary power generation ranging from hundreds of
kilowatts to megawatts – where reliability, low maintenance, and ability to cycle rapidly are
needed.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell in Power Generation][49]

[Fuel Cell in Power Generation]

#### Off Road & Material Handling

Productivity is crucial for many off-road and material handling applications. Zero-emission, fuel
cell-powered equipment allows operators to achieve significant economic and environmental benefits,
enhancing both efficiency and sustainability. Fuel cells also provide a path to decarbonization of
super heavy-duty off-road vehicles.

## EV Charging Questions, Answered

How do EV charging stations work?

Electric charging stations function by converting power from the electrical grid to direct current
that electric vehicles use. DC fast chargers, which allow quick charging in minutes using higher
voltages and wattages, are only available at public stations. 

Drivers plug their vehicles into the electric vehicle charging stations, which deliver power to the
vehicle's battery charging system. When done, drivers unplug so the next EV can charge up from the
ever-flowing grid power supply. Home stations wire directly into the home's electrical system.

[Answers to your questions when installing ev chargers.][18]

Are EV charging stations worth it?

Yes, due to all the long-term benefits. See below for the three primary reasons EV charging stations
are worthwhile.
1. **Preparing for the future:** As more people embrace electric vehicles, electric charging
   infrastructure will be necessary, and businesses that install stations will position themselves
   for future success. [EVs are here to stay][19].
2. **Reduced energy costs:** EVs are cheaper than gas vehicles, saving fleet operators money on
   fuel.
3. **Customer retention/attraction:** Having an electric charging station works to attract and
   retain customers, as EV drivers frequently visit places with convenient charging stations. 

Can owning an EV charging station be profitable?

Owning an EV charging station can be a profitable business opportunity as it has recurring revenue
streams. Offering an EV charging solution provides profit from charging fees. 

As the EV market continues expanding to [meet consumer demand and sustainability goals][20], more EV
drivers will need access to a commercial charging station, increasing the volume of fees an EV
charging station collects. Locating stations in busy areas like coffee shops, restaurants,
convenience stores, and malls is a great strategy to enhance an EV charging experience, [contribute
to sustainable transportation,][21] and make more profits.

Why should I consider installing an EV charging station?

One important reason to install an electric vehicle charging station is to demonstrate your
commitment to sustainability by supporting clean energy options. Then, as EV adoption increases,
you’ll be [ahead of the curve][22] by offering electric vehicle charging availability for customers.
You can generate income from fees, subscriptions, advertising, or premium parking by providing
charging. Any place with EV charging stations makes more profits as charging drives more foot
traffic and spending at shopping centers and parks.

What factors should I consider when choosing an EV charging station?

charging. Any place with EV charging stations makes more profits as charging drives more foot

What factors should I consider when choosing an EV charging station?

When choosing electric car charging stations, consider the following factors:
* Intended location
* Desired charging speeds
* Number of ports you’ll need
* Maximum power output 
* Payment options 
* Safety certifications
* Equipment warranties, service, and support

[Considerations for installing EV charging stations at your location.][23]

What types of EV charging stations do you offer?

At Blink, we offer electric vehicle charging station products for commercial and residential use. We
offer Level 2 charging stations and DC fast chargers for commercial properties. [Why should you
consider a Level 2 charging station?][24]

Our products provide Level 2 and DC fast charging capabilities in various form factors like
pedestals, wall mounts, and mobile units.

connectors or ports to remove debris. It’s also best to inspect ports for loose connections and
faults and perform software updates to optimize performance.

install new equipment, perform maintenance and repair, and perform remote monitoring to maintain
functionality.

* Desired charging speeds
* Number of ports you’ll need
* Maximum power output 
* Payment options 
* Safety certifications
* Equipment warranties, service, and support

[Considerations for installing EV charging stations at your location.][23]

What types of EV charging stations do you offer?

At Blink, we offer electric vehicle charging station products for commercial and residential use. We
offer Level 2 charging stations and DC fast chargers for commercial properties. [Why should you
consider a Level 2 charging station?][24]

Our products provide Level 2 and DC fast charging capabilities in various form factors like
pedestals, wall mounts, and mobile units.

Is any maintenance required for EV charging stations?

Yes, maintenance is required for electric cars’ charging stations to ensure proper and safe
operation and reduce downtime. [Ways of maintaining EV charge stations][25] include cleaning
connectors or ports to remove debris. It’s also best to inspect ports for loose connections and
faults and perform software updates to optimize performance. 

What support services do you offer?

Blink provides 24/7 customer support through multiple channels to address any questions. We also
install new equipment, perform maintenance and repair, and perform remote monitoring to maintain
functionality. 

Additional services include over-the-air software updates and training resources for customers and
partners. Blink aims to offer a reliable EV charging experience with around-the-clock assistance.

Blink offers [turnkey EV charging services][26], including installation, maintenance, and support,
to keep your charging stations running smoothly for longer.

## Ready to start designing your ideal EV Charging solution?

Learn how to use EV charging stations to attract new customers and increase duration and frequency
of visits at your business.

# Your all-in-one partner in EV charging

## Deploy a charging solution that fits your organizational goals.

* *What we do

We simplify your transition to electric. With more charging ports deployed than anyone in the
industry, we bring unmatched expertise and a complete portfolio of reliable hardware, intelligent
software and dependable services, delivering an EV charging solution tailored for your organization.

* *How we work with you

We are not station operators; we are charging solution enablers. Whether you’re an organization
looking to attract drivers to your place of business, a fleet focused on operating at maximum
efficiency or want to operate an EV charging business of your own, ChargePoint can help you deliver
a world- class EV charging program.

[Connect With an Expert][108]
[Person using the ChargePoint CMS]

## Innovation at our core

We engineer the most advanced EVSE technology from the ground up, giving you fully integrated
systems optimized for performance and value.
* Our stations are designed in-house with modular, easy-to-repair architecture, and innovations like
  ChargePoint® Omni Port and cut-resistant cables to deliver an unparalleled ownership experience.
* Built for any scale, the ChargePoint Platform gives you complete control and rich insights with
  our unified EV charge management system, while operating the hardware of your choice.
* Pairing our stations with ChargePoint software delivers functionality well beyond OCPP compliance
  with features like Waitlist, AI automation, and Fleet Operations.
* In partnership with Eaton, we’re extending our innovation behind the meter and co-developing
  technology that will define our industry into the future.

“It’s amazing to be able to log in, put in the metrics I want to pull and see live data on our
portfolio of stations.”

Laurie LeLack

Global Director, Corporate Real Estate

[Citrix Logo]
[Bus charging on ChargePoint Express 280]

## End-to-end reliability

Trust underpins customer success, and we deliver the confidence you need to scale as your business
grows.
* Keep stations performing and vehicles on the road with tailored support packages backed by
  experts.
* Let us take care of the driver experience with our complimentary 24/7 driver support.
* Rely on expert guidance for everything from initial site walks and first-time-right installations
  to long-term program optimization.

“It’s true bliss to log into a dashboard, see all the different sites with the chargers at a glance,
and know whether we need to scale further.”

Christian Boerger

Vice President of Revenue Strategy

[Oxford Collection Logo]
[Person tapping on ChargePoint CP6000]

## World-class driver experience

Connect with EV drivers when they want to charge.
* Reach our 4 million+ EV drivers and draw them to your stations via our mobile app and in-dash
  integrations.
* Serve more drivers with innovative solutions that ensure everyone can get a charge.
* Leverage the tools you need to build a world-class experience that keeps drivers coming back.

# Your all-in-one partner in EV charging

## Deploy a charging solution that fits your organizational goals.

* *What we do

We simplify your transition to electric. With more charging ports deployed than anyone in the
industry, we bring unmatched expertise and a complete portfolio of reliable hardware, intelligent
software and dependable services, delivering an EV charging solution tailored for your organization.

* *How we work with you

We are not station operators; we are charging solution enablers. Whether you’re an organization
looking to attract drivers to your place of business, a fleet focused on operating at maximum
efficiency or want to operate an EV charging business of your own, ChargePoint can help you deliver
a world- class EV charging program.

[Connect With an Expert][108]
[Person using the ChargePoint CMS]

## Innovation at our core

We engineer the most advanced EVSE technology from the ground up, giving you fully integrated
systems optimized for performance and value.
* Our stations are designed in-house with modular, easy-to-repair architecture, and innovations like
  ChargePoint® Omni Port and cut-resistant cables to deliver an unparalleled ownership experience.
* Built for any scale, the ChargePoint Platform gives you complete control and rich insights with
  our unified EV charge management system, while operating the hardware of your choice.
* Pairing our stations with ChargePoint software delivers functionality well beyond OCPP compliance
  with features like Waitlist, AI automation, and Fleet Operations.
* In partnership with Eaton, we’re extending our innovation behind the meter and co-developing
  technology that will define our industry into the future.

“It’s amazing to be able to log in, put in the metrics I want to pull and see live data on our
portfolio of stations.”

Laurie LeLack

Global Director, Corporate Real Estate

[Citrix Logo]
[Bus charging on ChargePoint Express 280]

## End-to-end reliability

Trust underpins customer success, and we deliver the confidence you need to scale as your business
grows.
* Keep stations performing and vehicles on the road with tailored support packages backed by
  experts.
* Let us take care of the driver experience with our complimentary 24/7 driver support.
* Rely on expert guidance for everything from initial site walks and first-time-right installations
  to long-term program optimization.

“It’s true bliss to log into a dashboard, see all the different sites with the chargers at a glance,
and know whether we need to scale further.”

Christian Boerger

Vice President of Revenue Strategy

[Oxford Collection Logo]
[Person tapping on ChargePoint CP6000]

## World-class driver experience

Connect with EV drivers when they want to charge.
* Reach our 4 million+ EV drivers and draw them to your stations via our mobile app and in-dash
  integrations.
* Serve more drivers with innovative solutions that ensure everyone can get a charge.
* Leverage the tools you need to build a world-class experience that keeps drivers coming back.

# Your all-in-one partner in EV charging

## Deploy a charging solution that fits your organizational goals.

* *What we do

We simplify your transition to electric. With more charging ports deployed than anyone in the
industry, we bring unmatched expertise and a complete portfolio of reliable hardware, intelligent
software and dependable services, delivering an EV charging solution tailored for your organization.

* *How we work with you

We are not station operators; we are charging solution enablers. Whether you’re an organization
looking to attract drivers to your place of business, a fleet focused on operating at maximum
efficiency or want to operate an EV charging business of your own, ChargePoint can help you deliver
a world- class EV charging program.

[Connect With an Expert][108]
[Person using the ChargePoint CMS]

## Innovation at our core

We engineer the most advanced EVSE technology from the ground up, giving you fully integrated
systems optimized for performance and value.
* Our stations are designed in-house with modular, easy-to-repair architecture, and innovations like
  ChargePoint® Omni Port and cut-resistant cables to deliver an unparalleled ownership experience.
* Built for any scale, the ChargePoint Platform gives you complete control and rich insights with
  our unified EV charge management system, while operating the hardware of your choice.
* Pairing our stations with ChargePoint software delivers functionality well beyond OCPP compliance
  with features like Waitlist, AI automation, and Fleet Operations.
* In partnership with Eaton, we’re extending our innovation behind the meter and co-developing
  technology that will define our industry into the future.

“It’s amazing to be able to log in, put in the metrics I want to pull and see live data on our
portfolio of stations.”

Laurie LeLack

Global Director, Corporate Real Estate

## End-to-end reliability

Trust underpins customer success, and we deliver the confidence you need to scale as your business
grows.
* Keep stations performing and vehicles on the road with tailored support packages backed by
  experts.
* Let us take care of the driver experience with our complimentary 24/7 driver support.
* Rely on expert guidance for everything from initial site walks and first-time-right installations
  to long-term program optimization.

Decarbonize your business with advanced zero-emissions technologies that deliver reliable,
sustainable power.

[European zero-emissions truck cab]

## Customize your power solution

We know there's no one-size-fits-all solution for decarbonization, so we built a broad portfolio of
electric for commercial transportation and industrial applications.

##### Engineer Expertise

#### Your trusted guide on the electrification journey

Our engineering experts help you navigate the complexities of the process, carefully evaluating
industry standards and regulations to make sure your solution meets — or exceeds — your
expectations.

[Learn More][76]

[Engineering Expertise][Engineering Expertise]

##### Vehicle & Equipment Integration

#### Tailored solutions designed to meet your specific applications

Each vehicle project is unique, so we tailor our support to OEM needs, ensuring seamless battery
integration — from software interfaces and bug resolution to mechanical mounting, thermal
management, and safety compliance.

[Learn More][77]

[Vehicle and Equipment Integration][Vehicle and Equipment Integration]

##### Servicing & Training

#### Partnership that extends beyond product delivery

From OEM and dealer training to after-sale servicing and parts, our team is equipped to assist you
in addressing any challenges or needs that may arise to ensure your long-term success.

[Learn More][78]

[Servicing and Training][Servicing and Training]
Benefits

## Innovative design. Built to last.

[Compare Batteries][79]

[angled bottom battery][angled bottom battery]

[Safety icon][Safety icon]

###### Safety

Each battery is designed with advanced active and passive safety features to mitigate risks and
ensure optimal performance on the road.

[Durability icon][Durability icon]

###### Durability

Ballistic-grade enclosures and rigorous in-house testing, including vibration, impact, and crush
tests, ensure our batteries can withstand the most demanding environments.

[Energy Density icon][Energy Density icon]

###### Energy Density

Our designs incorporate top-tier cylindrical cells that charge quickly and provide industry-leading
energy density, enabling long-range travel for high-weight ratings.

[Scalability icon][Scalability icon]

###### Scalability

We design our packs with a scalable, modular platform that can be tailored to various vehicle types,
duty cycles, and energy systems ranging from 40 kWh to over 200 kWh.

energy density, enabling long-range travel for high-weight ratings.

duty cycles, and energy systems ranging from 40 kWh to over 200 kWh.

# Charge simply. Move Freely.

Your everyday journeys, powered by simple, accessible charging.

[ Download the JOLT App ][31]
[ Find a charger ][32]
Charging made for real life.

EV charging should feel simple. That’s why our network is built around the places people go:
shopping centres, grocery stores, entertainment centres, workplace zones and lifestyle hubs.

Whether you’re running errands, commuting or taking a weekend trip, you can count on a charging
experience that is built for your routine.

## The JOLT app makes charging simpler.

A seamless way to charge, from start to finish.
* Quickly find nearby chargers
* Start and stop sessions in seconds
* View pricing clearly
* Track usage and receipts
* Get notified when charging is complete

## Simple. Familiar. Easy to use.

### EV chargers coast to coast in key destinations

A national network designed to give drivers more options where it matters.

### Reliable, app-enabled charging

Locate chargers, start sessions and track charging activity quickly and easily.

### Built for modern EV drivers

JOLT supports the most common connectors so you can plug in and get on with your day.
Helping more people switch to electric, every day.

Our mission is simple: make it faster, easier and simpler for people to switch to EVs.

By expanding access to convenient charging across the U.S., JOLT helps remove friction from EV
adoption — one charge at a time.

Across the places you already visit.
From retail destinations to urban hubs, JOLT’s network continues to grow across the U.S.
[ Find a JOLT charger ][33]

## Need help?

Reach out to our Driver Support Team for help. We’ll get back to you within 24 hours.

# Charge simply. Move Freely.

Your everyday journeys, powered by simple, accessible charging.

[ Download the JOLT App ][31]
[ Find a charger ][32]
Charging made for real life.

EV charging should feel simple. That’s why our network is built around the places people go:
shopping centres, grocery stores, entertainment centres, workplace zones and lifestyle hubs.

Whether you’re running errands, commuting or taking a weekend trip, you can count on a charging
experience that is built for your routine.

## The JOLT app makes charging simpler.

A seamless way to charge, from start to finish.
* Quickly find nearby chargers
* Start and stop sessions in seconds
* View pricing clearly
* Track usage and receipts
* Get notified when charging is complete

## Simple. Familiar. Easy to use.

### EV chargers coast to coast in key destinations

A national network designed to give drivers more options where it matters.

### Reliable, app-enabled charging

Locate chargers, start sessions and track charging activity quickly and easily.

### Built for modern EV drivers

JOLT supports the most common connectors so you can plug in and get on with your day.
Helping more people switch to electric, every day.

Our mission is simple: make it faster, easier and simpler for people to switch to EVs.

By expanding access to convenient charging across the U.S., JOLT helps remove friction from EV
adoption — one charge at a time.

Across the places you already visit.
From retail destinations to urban hubs, JOLT’s network continues to grow across the U.S.
[ Find a JOLT charger ][33]

## Need help?

Reach out to our Driver Support Team for help. We’ll get back to you within 24 hours.

## Natural gas

Natural gas is the most widely used alternative fuel with tens of millions of vehicles in use.
Natural gas vehicles run on either compressed natural gas or liquified natural gas. Fleet operators
enjoy the stable prices and up to 40% lower fueling costs.

alternative fuel for vehicles. Like natural gas, fleet operators enjoy price stability while also
seeing the benefits of easily accessible and low cost on-site fueling infrastructure.

## electric/Hybrid

Electric and hybrid electric vehicles are becoming more prevalent in the transportation industry.
EVs produce no exhaust pipe emission, less maintenance is required, and reduce fuel costs
dramatically. Hybrid vehicles have both an electric motor and a typical gasoline or diesel engine
which can enhance miles per gallon.

* ### What types of documents do you translate?
  
  At Accelingo, we offer professional language services that cater to all your linguistic needs. We

  resonates with them culturally as well. That’s why we offer comprehensive localization services
  that take into account all aspects of your content, from cultural nuances to formatting and
  design. We work with a team of experienced professionals who are not only experts in language, but
  also in the cultures of the languages they work with. So you can be sure that your message will be
  accurately and effectively conveyed to your target audience, no matter where they are in the
  world.
* ### How do you handle confidential information?
  
  We take confidentiality very seriously, and we understand that your content is sensitive and
  valuable. That’s why we have strict measures in place to ensure the highest level of security for
  your documents. All our translators sign non-disclosure agreements, and we use encrypted
  technology to transfer and store files. Additionally, we can also sign your company’s
  confidentiality agreement if needed. You can trust us to handle your confidential information with
  the utmost care and professionalism.
* ### What industries do you provide language services for?
  
  We provide language services for a wide range of industries, including finance, technology,
  healthcare, legal, engineering, eLearning, and more. Our team of professional linguists and
  subject matter experts have experience working with various industry-specific terminologies,
  ensuring accurate and localized translations that truly resonate with your target audience.
  Whether you’re looking to expand your business to new markets or simply need to communicate
  effectively with multilingual stakeholders, our language solutions will help you achieve your
  goals with confidence.
* ### How long does a translation typically take?
  
  The time it takes to complete a translation can vary based on several factors such as the length

# The Alternative Fuel
# Vehicle Training Leader

Professional instructors, personal support, and flexible learning options to fit your needs.
**AFVi is the only independent ASE-accredited training provider in the entire alternative fuels
industry.**

### Natural Gas

Comprehensive training solutions for drivers, technicians, fleet managers and fueling managers of
CNG and RNG vehicles.

[ Training Options ][125]

### Propane

Targeted training solutions for technicians and fleet managers who maintain and inspect
propane-powered vehicles.

[ Training Options ][126]

### Hydrogen

Complete training solutions for technicians and fleet managers of both hydrogen fuel cell and
internal combustion vehicles.

[ Training Options ][127]

### Electric

AFVi’s comprehensive electric vehicle training courses provide maximum risk mitigation to your
entire user chain.

## AFS Propane Conversions and parts

#### Alternative Fuel Systems, Inc.

  

Alternative Fuel Systems, Inc. (AFS), a "Solutions Company" of 50 years, is the world's leading
provider of OEM and aftermarket Off-road, Industrial natural gas or LPG (propane) fuel systems,
components, ancillary and service parts. Currently, AFS offers more than 600 different fuel systems
that are 100% tested and designed for easy installation. 

AFS is proud to be one of IMPCOs / GFIs largest and oldest global industrial distributors. What
separates AFS from other distributors is the value of our technical experience in fuel system
applications and design, emission calibrations, troubleshooting, maintenance and repairs, and
expeditor of service parts from our extensive inventory.

AFS also manufactures its own line of custom industrial products, that include pilot actuated (2
stage) electric lock-offs, fuel filters, bulkhead filters, inline thermostats and UL approved fuel
hose.

AFS is a major distributor for Parker (Fuel hoses and fittings), REGO (fittings and Tank valves).
AFS also has sales agreements to promote Bosch (selected fuel system components), and other
manufacturers of fuel system components. You will also see all these products promoted on our
website and more.

AFS is committed to be the best value provider in the Industrial Market place for alternative fuel
systems, ancillary, and service parts. We will continue to technically support our customer. We will
continue to offer the world’s largest inventory of fuel system kits. We will continue to carry the
most diversified inventory of parts to give our customers the 100% fill rate on their service parts
orders. We will continue to expand our product line offerings and lastly, we are committed to be the
most competitive supplier on the products that we market.

If you are already a customer of AFS, we thank you for your support and continued business. If you
are not a customer of AFS, please give us an opportunity to give you the products and services you
require. 

Let** AFS** be your Solutions Provider.

enjoy a low first-fill price when you switch.

Manage your propane services online with a MyAmeriGas account - order propane, check delivery
status, pay your bill, & connect with support agents. Sign up & log in today!

business, and your life running.

No matter what you need or when you need it, we're here for you. You can rely on AmeriGas to keep

# About CAAFI

CAAFI’s focus areas have been consistent since its establishment in 2006. They are:

#### CAAFI Focus Areas

[Feedstocks ][45]

Encourage innovation in agricultural and forestry sectors to unlock new fuel pathways and promote
domestic production and sourcing of feedstocks to support rural economies and enhance energy
security.

[Fuel Qualification ][46]

Streamline certification processes and serve as a convening organization to accelerate market entry
for SATF. 

[Supply Chain Development ][47]

Facilitate the development of robust, SATF supply chains that support job creation and
infrastructure investment. 

[Deployment ][48]

Facilitate best practices and track deployment of fuel and feedstock production efforts.

[End Users ][49]

Engage airlines, airports, and fuel providers to drive demand through market-based solutions.
Showcase cost-competitive SATF options that meet end user needs.

[International Activities ][50]

Focus on coordination, collaboration, and strategic partnerships.

CAAFI works with our public, private, and non-governmental sector stakeholders in support of
achieving industry and U.S. government objectives. These objectives are often laid out in guiding
documents, initiatives, or plans. CAAFI develops resources that support knowledge dissemination and
communication about SAF and organizes, leads, or advises activities to advance industry and
government goals. A timeline showing the various government actions in support of SAF development is
below. 

[More About CAAFI][51]

# About CAAFI

CAAFI’s focus areas have been consistent since its establishment in 2006. They are:

#### CAAFI Focus Areas

[Feedstocks ][45]

Encourage innovation in agricultural and forestry sectors to unlock new fuel pathways and promote
domestic production and sourcing of feedstocks to support rural economies and enhance energy
security.

[Fuel Qualification ][46]

Streamline certification processes and serve as a convening organization to accelerate market entry
for SATF. 

[Supply Chain Development ][47]

Facilitate the development of robust, SATF supply chains that support job creation and
infrastructure investment. 

[Deployment ][48]

Facilitate best practices and track deployment of fuel and feedstock production efforts.

[End Users ][49]

Engage airlines, airports, and fuel providers to drive demand through market-based solutions.
Showcase cost-competitive SATF options that meet end user needs.

[International Activities ][50]

Focus on coordination, collaboration, and strategic partnerships.

CAAFI works with our public, private, and non-governmental sector stakeholders in support of
achieving industry and U.S. government objectives. These objectives are often laid out in guiding
documents, initiatives, or plans. CAAFI develops resources that support knowledge dissemination and
communication about SAF and organizes, leads, or advises activities to advance industry and
government goals. A timeline showing the various government actions in support of SAF development is
below. 

[More About CAAFI][51]

## ChargeHub FAQ

### What is ChargeHub?

ChargeHub connects all the players in the electric mobility ecosystem and offers solutions that
simplify charging for electromobilists and businesses alike. The ChargeHub app makes it easy for EV
drivers to find charging stations and pay for their charging session, while our business solutions
simplify EV roaming, payments and data integration across North America.

### Will ChargeHub charging stations map remain free?

Electric car drivers will always be able to download the ChargeHub charging stations app and use the
charging stations map for free.

### Can I use ChargeHub to pay for charging directly?

You can use ChargeHub to pay for recharging at over 160,000 compatible ports, marked with an orange
lightning bolt on our interactive map. You can also use filters to display only those stations that
can be activated by ChargeHub.

### What is ChargeHub's coverage of public charging ports in Canada and the USA?

ChargeHub lists nearly 265,000 public charging ports in Canada and the United States. The
application makes it easy to locate them, plan trips, and activate and pay for charging sessions on
compatible networks.

### Which businesses does ChargeHub partner with?

ChargeHub works primarily with charging station operators (CPOs) and electric mobility providers
(eMSPs), such as fleets and automakers. Its solutions are also tailored to other electric
vehicle-related industries, including associations, governments, municipalities and many others.

## ChargeHub FAQ

### What is ChargeHub?

ChargeHub connects all the players in the electric mobility ecosystem and offers solutions that
simplify charging for electromobilists and businesses alike. The ChargeHub app makes it easy for EV
drivers to find charging stations and pay for their charging session, while our business solutions
simplify EV roaming, payments and data integration across North America.

### Will ChargeHub charging stations map remain free?

Electric car drivers will always be able to download the ChargeHub charging stations app and use the
charging stations map for free.

### Can I use ChargeHub to pay for charging directly?

You can use ChargeHub to pay for recharging at over 160,000 compatible ports, marked with an orange
lightning bolt on our interactive map. You can also use filters to display only those stations that
can be activated by ChargeHub.

### What is ChargeHub's coverage of public charging ports in Canada and the USA?

ChargeHub lists nearly 265,000 public charging ports in Canada and the United States. The
application makes it easy to locate them, plan trips, and activate and pay for charging sessions on
compatible networks.

### Which businesses does ChargeHub partner with?

ChargeHub works primarily with charging station operators (CPOs) and electric mobility providers
(eMSPs), such as fleets and automakers. Its solutions are also tailored to other electric
vehicle-related industries, including associations, governments, municipalities and many others.

# Your Ultimate Charging Solution

[EACharger-beneficial]

#### Beneficial

Cost effective investment that ensures efficient charging and minimal maintenance

[EACharger-progressive]

#### Progressive

Continuous improvement ensures our product remains at the forefront of quality and innovation

[EACharger-flexible]

#### Flexible

Adaptive and fully customizable orders meeting your project’s specific needs and requirements

[EACharger-reliable]

#### Reliable

Inherited aviation industry standards guarantee reliability even in harsh climates

[EACharger-supported]

#### Supported

24/7 web support and local service partners for customer satisfaction

[EACharger-reputable]

#### Reputable

Crafted by award winning Estonian manufacturer with years of experience

## EACharger DC

A reliable and and elegant solution for rapid charging in public places, including highways,
shopping centers, gas stations, and other high-traffic areas. The DC charging station is compatible
with CCS Combo2, CHAdeMO, and AC charging standards.

##### Main features:
* Secure and durable at the design level
* Various safety mechanisms for comprehensive protection
* Latest software and online updates
* Scalable power range

[See more][15]

## EACharger AC

A universal and attractive solution for urban areas: residential municipal parking lots, airports,
shopping malls, stadiums, etc. Easy installation and low maintenance cost. Three-phase and
single-phase variants with up to two channels and additional options.

##### Main features:
* Easy installation and setup
* Complete compatibility with OCPP 1.6J
* Dynamic load management (DLM) algorithm
* Wide range of customization possibilities

[See more][16]
[EACharger AC Charging Station]

## EACharger HPC

A powerful and easy-to-use DC charging station for electric busses and electric heavy-duty vehicles.
Ideal solution for fleet operators, including freight carriers, city bus companies and trucking
companies. The main standard is CCS Combo2, others are optional.

##### Main features:
* Charging sessions monitoring and reporting
* Load balancing with remote control option
* Prioritization and reservation capabilities
* Integration with existing software

[See more][17]

## EACharger Hub

A powerful and intelligent solution for charging points that allows the charging of multiple
electric vehicles at one location using a Dynamic1 (Dynamic Load Management) algorithm. It offers
the flexibility of implementation in combined versions, supporting both AC and DC charging stations.

##### Main features:
* Centralized charging management system/li>
* Flexibility for customization to suit specific requirements
* Customer reports and recommendations
* Power balancing based on real-time conditions

[EACharger DC Hub Solution icon]

## Who Are We?

ElectroAir is an Estonian company, founded in 2006, specializing in the design, development and
manufacturing [Ground Power Units for aviation industry][18]. With a well-recognized presence and
involvement in various projects worldwide, we prioritize environmental care by reducing our carbon
footprint. This journey led us to explore the world of e-mobility, and in 2021, we strategically
decided to expand our product portfolio with cutting-edge charging solutions for electric vehicles,
resulting in the successful launch and installation of the first EACharger within a year. The
EACharger has proven to be an excellent performer, establishing itself as a reliable and modern EV
charging station. With our commitment to continuous improvement, we ensure that our products
maintain exceptional quality and innovation.

[About us][19]
16000 m²
100 Employees
497 Clients
100 Countries

# Your Ultimate Charging Solution

[EACharger-beneficial]

#### Beneficial

Cost effective investment that ensures efficient charging and minimal maintenance

[EACharger-progressive]

#### Progressive

Continuous improvement ensures our product remains at the forefront of quality and innovation

[EACharger-flexible]

#### Flexible

Adaptive and fully customizable orders meeting your project’s specific needs and requirements

[EACharger-reliable]

#### Reliable

Inherited aviation industry standards guarantee reliability even in harsh climates

[EACharger-supported]

#### Supported

24/7 web support and local service partners for customer satisfaction

[EACharger-reputable]

#### Reputable

Crafted by award winning Estonian manufacturer with years of experience

## EACharger DC

A reliable and and elegant solution for rapid charging in public places, including highways,
shopping centers, gas stations, and other high-traffic areas. The DC charging station is compatible
with CCS Combo2, CHAdeMO, and AC charging standards.

##### Main features:
* Secure and durable at the design level
* Various safety mechanisms for comprehensive protection
* Latest software and online updates
* Scalable power range

[See more][15]

## EACharger AC

A universal and attractive solution for urban areas: residential municipal parking lots, airports,
shopping malls, stadiums, etc. Easy installation and low maintenance cost. Three-phase and
single-phase variants with up to two channels and additional options.

##### Main features:
* Easy installation and setup
* Complete compatibility with OCPP 1.6J
* Dynamic load management (DLM) algorithm
* Wide range of customization possibilities

[See more][16]
[EACharger AC Charging Station]

## EACharger HPC

A powerful and easy-to-use DC charging station for electric busses and electric heavy-duty vehicles.
Ideal solution for fleet operators, including freight carriers, city bus companies and trucking
companies. The main standard is CCS Combo2, others are optional.

##### Main features:
* Charging sessions monitoring and reporting
* Load balancing with remote control option
* Prioritization and reservation capabilities
* Integration with existing software

[See more][17]

## EACharger Hub

A powerful and intelligent solution for charging points that allows the charging of multiple
electric vehicles at one location using a Dynamic1 (Dynamic Load Management) algorithm. It offers
the flexibility of implementation in combined versions, supporting both AC and DC charging stations.

##### Main features:
* Centralized charging management system/li>
* Flexibility for customization to suit specific requirements
* Customer reports and recommendations
* Power balancing based on real-time conditions

[EACharger DC Hub Solution icon]

## Who Are We?

ElectroAir is an Estonian company, founded in 2006, specializing in the design, development and
manufacturing [Ground Power Units for aviation industry][18]. With a well-recognized presence and
involvement in various projects worldwide, we prioritize environmental care by reducing our carbon
footprint. This journey led us to explore the world of e-mobility, and in 2021, we strategically
decided to expand our product portfolio with cutting-edge charging solutions for electric vehicles,
resulting in the successful launch and installation of the first EACharger within a year. The
EACharger has proven to be an excellent performer, establishing itself as a reliable and modern EV
charging station. With our commitment to continuous improvement, we ensure that our products
maintain exceptional quality and innovation.

[About us][19]

100 Employees
497 Clients
100 Countries

## Driving Towards Efficiency

The third annual Old World Industries Sustainability Report is Live! Learn about our continued
investment in sustainability through our environmental actions, our people, and our governance.

and the world.

In your drive towards a career, consider us your GPS.

We've developed resources to help navigate the road to becoming a technician - or any number of jobs
in the world of vehicles. Hear from students, teachers and professionals. Explore opportunities you
may not have considered. 

[Explore now][162]

## OWI Brands

Old World Industries' world-class brands help keep America's vehicles on the road and out of the
shop.

## OWI Commercial Products

Our industry leading commercial products drive business forward. Through new innovative solutions,
world-class quality, performance and reliability, we keep fleets on the road and out of the shop. We
know downtime is not an option.

## OWI Retail Products

All of our industry leading consumer products deliver best in class performance that you can trust.
We're committed to helping you get more life and optimum performance from your vehicle.

[MDPI Academic Video Service: Advancing Visual Scholarly Communication][30]
[Encyclopedia MDPI is thrilled to announce significant enhancements to its Academic Video Service,
which aim to improve its quality, accessibility, and functionality. Since its launch, our video
service has enabled numerous scholars to present their research in a dynamic and visually engaging
format, greatly enhancing its visibility and impact. Due to the overwhelmingly positive reception
this service has received, we have reached a point where the number of orders we are receiving
exceeds our current capacity. In order to maintain the quality of these videos and continue
optimizing the service, we have made the decision to introduce a fee. However, to ensure that this
service is still a cost-effective option, we have set our prices significantly below the market
average. 1. Highlights of the Upgrades to the Service Although the service will now be fee-based, we
are committed to providing even more professional and comprehensive support, including the
following: One-on-one video production guidance Personalized assistance to ensure your needs are
fully met. Scriptwriting and English editing Expertly crafted narratives and professional English
editing to ensure your research is presented clearly, accurately, and with impact. High-quality
animations Visually engaging animations are created to simplify complex research and captivate your
audience. Whiteboard Animations: Clean and minimalist, using hand-drawn illustrations to explain
ideas step-by-step. Motion Graphics (MG) Animations: Cartoon Style: Bright, colorful, and
approachable, ideal for making technical or scientific content more accessible and engaging.
Hand-Drawn Style: Unique and artistic, adding a personal touch to your research while maintaining
clarity and professionalism. Customized infographics (optional) We can also create tailored
infographics to visually summarize key data or findings, enhancing the clarity and appeal of your
video. Native voiceover Native speakers provide voiceovers to enhance the accessibility and reach of
your research. Multiple rounds of revision To ensure your video accurately represents your work.
Social media promotion Expanding your research's visibility and impact. 2. Why Choose Us? The Proven
Impact of Video Abstracts Research shows that a well-crafted video abstract can significantly
enhance the visibility and impact of your work. It has been shown to do the following: Increase
paper views by 120% （Source: 10.1007/ s11192-019-03108-w） Boost citations by 20% （Source: Wiley
Online Library） Improve journal rankings by 33% （Source: Research Square） Raise Altmetrics scores
by 140% （Source: Research Square） Our Expertise in Academic Research Backed by MDPI, our
experienced production team combines deep academic knowledge with creative excellence. We understand
the nuances of scholarly communication and ensure that every frame accurately conveys the value of
your research, meeting the highest standards of quality and precision. Collaborations with SCI
Journals We have partnered with over 60 SCI journals to create exclusive video series, enhancing the
dissemination and impact of published research. For example, our collaborations with Entropy, Remote
Sensing, Nanomaterials , Animals , Nutrients, Foods , Sustainability, Cancers, etc., have helped
authors achieve greater visibility and recognition for their work. Global visibility The videos are
linked to your paper's DOI for maximum exposure. Available Video Services and Their Pricing Video
Abstract (up to 5 minutes long): Summarizes the key findings, methodology, and significance of your
research paper. Regular Price: 600 CHF Short Take (up to 2 minutes long): Uses original animations
to explain the specific aspects of your research. Regular Price: 5

for treating severe aortic valve disease. While conventional surgical aortic valve replacement

implantation by reducing the need for multiple sutures, with the goal of shortening operative time
and facilitating minimally invasive surgery. More than a decade after its introduction, clinical
experience with sutureless valves has grown substantially. At the same time, rapid progress in

reshaped the treatment landscape. A recent study published in the Journal of Clinical Medicine,

Replacement: A Bibliographic Meta-Analysis and Clinical Considerations", reviews the current

multiple comorbidities, techniques that simplify valve implantation have attracted considerable
interest. Sutureless valves were developed to address this challenge. By reducing the number of
sutures required during implantation, they may simplify the procedure while maintaining the
principles of surgical valve replacement. The technology also complements minimally invasive
surgical approaches, where the limited operative field can make conventional suturing more
technically demanding. For these reasons, SuAVR attracted considerable attention as a potential way
to improve procedural efficiency while preserving the established benefits of surgical valve
replacement. 2. What the Current Evidence Suggests Over the past decade, a substantial body of
clinical evidence has accumulated on sutureless valve implantation. To better understand how this
evidence has evolved, the authors systematically reviewed 538 published studies on SuAVR. The
analysis showed that most of the available evidence comes from observational studies, while
randomized controlled trials account for only 1.3% of the published literature. Although SuAVR has
been investigated extensively, the limited availability of randomized evidence means that important
clinical questions remain incompletely answered. Across the published literature, one of the most
consistent findings is that SuAVR is associated with shorter aortic cross-clamp and cardiopulmonary
bypass times than conventional SAVR. These procedural advantages may be particularly relevant in
patients undergoing minimally invasive surgery or in those for whom reducing operative time is
desirable. At the same time, the paper notes that concerns remain regarding long-term valve
durability, pacemaker implantation, and procedural costs. These issues continue to influence how the
technology is evaluated and adopted in clinical practice. 3. Clinical Use Has Continued to Evolve

relatively limited. The paper found that approximately 80% of the published literature originated
from Europe, whereas North America contributed fewer than 10% of publications, highlighting a marked
geographical imbalance in both research activity and clinical use. The authors suggest that this
pattern may reflect a combination of factors, including earlier regulatory approval in Europe,
differences in reimbursement policies, and variation in patient populations. At the same time, the
rapid expansion of TAVR has transformed the treatment of aortic valve disease, while conventional
SAVR has continued to evolve through refinements in surgical techniques and prosthetic valve

## Preguntas Frecuentes

Todo lo que necesitas saber para tu visita al Sitio Real.

#### ¿Qué es lo más importante que ver en Aranjuez?

expand_more
Los tres pilares fundamentales son el Palacio Real, el Jardín del Príncipe (que alberga la Casa del
Labrador y el Museo de Falúas Reales) y el Jardín de la Isla. No olvide pasear por el casco
histórico, diseñado en una cuadrícula perfecta propia de la Ilustración.

#### ¿Cómo puedo llegar desde Madrid?

expand_more
La forma más común es el tren de Cercanías (Línea C-3) desde las estaciones de Atocha o Sol, con un
trayecto de unos 45-50 minutos. También puede llegar en coche por la A-4. Durante la temporada de
primavera y otoño, el histórico "Tren de la Fresa" ofrece una experiencia temática inolvidable.

#### ¿Dónde se recomienda comer en la ciudad?

expand_more
Aranjuez es famoso por sus productos de la huerta, especialmente espárragos y fresones. Encontrará
desde restaurantes tradicionales de alta cocina cerca del Palacio hasta acogedores bistrós y
terrazas junto al río Tajo que sirven platos típicos con toques modernos.

#### ¿Es necesario reservar las entradas al Palacio con antelación?

expand_more
Es altamente recomendable, especialmente durante los fines de semana y festivos, para asegurar su
franja horaria preferida y evitar colas. Los jardines son de acceso gratuito, pero el interior del
Palacio y la Casa del Labrador requieren entrada gestionada por Patrimonio Nacional.

#### ¿Cuánto tiempo se necesita para visitar Aranjuez?

expand_more
Para una visita completa que incluya el Palacio y los principales jardines, se recomienda dedicar al
menos un día completo (6-8 horas). Si desea disfrutar de una comida pausada y explorar el casco
antiguo con calma, una estancia de fin de semana es ideal.

# Leading the transition to reliable, affordable alternative fuel

### Freedom delivers dependable RNG fuel solutions that reduce risk, control costs, and give fleets
### the confidence to move into the future.

### Your Partner in Reliable RNG Fuel

Freedom designs and delivers mobile and fixed fueling solutions built for the realities of fleet
operations. From compressed renewable natural gas (RNG) to fully integrated infrastructure, every
system is engineered for consistency, uptime, and long-term performance.

Trusted by fleet operators across North America, we help you adopt alternative fuels with clarity
and confidence.

[ Learn More About Freedom ][40]

### Progress Without Disruption

We don’t chase innovation for its own sake. Every solution is tested, refined, and proven to perform
in the field, so you can move forward without putting operations at risk.

[ Explore Our Infrastructure Solutions ][41]

### Specialists in High-Pressure Gaseous Fuels

Deep technical expertise in high-pressure, renewable gas systems delivered with the precision and
reliability critical to fleet performance.

# Leading the transition to reliable, affordable alternative fuel

### Freedom delivers dependable RNG fuel solutions that reduce risk, control costs, and give fleets
### the confidence to move into the future.

### Your Partner in Reliable RNG Fuel

Freedom designs and delivers mobile and fixed fueling solutions built for the realities of fleet
operations. From compressed renewable natural gas (RNG) to fully integrated infrastructure, every
system is engineered for consistency, uptime, and long-term performance.

Trusted by fleet operators across North America, we help you adopt alternative fuels with clarity
and confidence.

[ Learn More About Freedom ][40]

### Progress Without Disruption

We don’t chase innovation for its own sake. Every solution is tested, refined, and proven to perform
in the field, so you can move forward without putting operations at risk.

[ Explore Our Infrastructure Solutions ][41]

### Specialists in High-Pressure Gaseous Fuels

Deep technical expertise in high-pressure, renewable gas systems delivered with the precision and
reliability critical to fleet performance.

[
Renewable Nature Gas (RNG)
][42] [
SPOKE: SWIFT™ Mobile Fuel Solutions
][43]

### Integrated Infrastructure. End-to-End Confidence.

Freedom is a solutions partner built around one goal: making alternative fuel dependable and
economically viable at every stage.

[
[Strategy & Consultation]

### Strategy & Consultation

Clear, practical pathways tailored to your operational and regulatory realities.

][44] [
[Design & Planning]

### Design & Planning

Infrastructure designed for today’s demand and tomorrow’s scale.

][45] [
[Build & Installation]

### Build & Installation

Seamless delivery from experienced teams who understand what’s at stake.

][46] [
[Service & Maintenance]

### Service & Maintenance

24/7 support to ensure uptime, performance, and peace of mind.

][47] [
[Infrastructure Solutions]

### Infrastructure Solutions

Hub-and-Spoke platform that leverages high-capacity compression and virtual pipeline logistics to
efficiently deliver fuel to distributed end-use locations through our industry leading mobile SWIFT
unit.

][48] [
[Gaseous Fuel supply]

### Gaseous Fuel supply

An integrated C/RNG fuel supply platform utilizing a centralized hub-and-spoke model

][49]

Locations

## Freedom Fuel Stations

Beyond our private customer locations, we currently operate public Freedom fueling stations in the
Houston and Denver metropolitan areas. These locations are open 24 hours a day 7 days a week,
including holidays, and accept most major credit and fleet cards. Immediate or emergency service is
available 24/7 by calling **1-833-264-FUEL.**

Your location

## Looking For A Better Energy Solution?

 

Proven performance, reliable infrastructure, and immediate emissions reductions for your fleet.

The Agent Design Canvas
A design method for executives & small businesses

# The Agent
# Design *Canvas*

Eight principles and one working canvas for designing an AI agent — from a single job to a system
that scales. Built to be read in one sweep, before anyone opens a platform.

**Synthesis of** 7 source guides **Read order** Principles → Canvas → Anatomy → Autonomy → Patterns
→ Guardrails → Sequence **Rule** Design one agent before designing a system
The map

## One agent, at a glance

Everything in this guide, arranged so the layout itself shows the relationships. The core sits at
the centre; each ring outward is a layer that **contains and governs** the one inside it, and the
work runs as a **loop** around the middle. Read **outward** along a spoke to see how a capability is
powered, bounded and supported. Read **around** to follow the cycle. The step-by-step version of the
same design lives in Section 02.

Centre · Core

Identity + Job. Who is acting and the result it owns — everything attaches here.

Ring 2 · Capabilities

The components that power the loop: model, prompt, tools, memory, orchestration.

Ring 3 · Bounded autonomy

The boundary that contains the agent: permissions, gates, fallback, kill switch.

Ring 4 · System & assurance

The world it runs in: shared support, audit, live checks, the model service.

System authority

Sets the rules, approvals and change rights the whole circle runs under.

Identity & access

Every agent its own verified identity · least privilege · zero-trust. The dashed spokes show it
threading from the core to permissions and audit.

Earned autonomy

The core climbs outward over time: read → draft → supervised → extended.

Measure & prove

result · cost · speed · risk · demand. Change only through recorded evidence.

Core & work loop Capabilities Bounded autonomy System & assurance Identity thread

Hover a quadrant to trace one spoke — the loop phase, the capability it uses, the control that

#### Set the job & limits

#### Model

Component 5

* **Reflection**Critique and refine its own output
* **Tree-of-thoughts**Explore options when search pays off

* **Supervisor–worker**Manager breaks a goal into subtasks
* **Parallel fan-out**Many views at once, then merge
* **Prompt chain**Output of one step feeds the next

Stop it immediately — kill the trigger or pull write acc

* **Human-in-the-loop gate**Pause for sign-off on high-consequence acts
* **Act-then-verify**A checker pass before continuing
* **Self-check / LLM-as-judge**Inspect output for errors and drift
* **Input sanitisation**Strict schemas; block injection
* **Programmable rails**Topic, dialogue and execution limits
06

## Four mechanisms of bounded autonomy

Instructions are not enough — a strong prompt is only part of the answer. The real controls live in
the architecture: what the agent can access, what it can do, and where a human must approve.

#### Permissions

What the agent can access and change. Grant the minimum; expand only after it proves reliable.

#### Approval gates

Points where a human must authorise before the agent continues — for anything irreversible,
sensitive or first-time.

#### Fallbacks

What happens when it can’t continue: route to a human, return a flagged partial, or stop and log.
Never push forward broken.

#### Kill switch

Stop it immediately — kill the trigger or pull write acc

# Our Mission

Greater Rochester Clean Cities is a U.S. Department of Energy designated coalition in the Clean
Cities and Communities partnership. We work  to advance affordable, efficient, and clean
transportation fuels, energy efficient mobility-systems, and other fuel-saving technologies and
practices throughout the Greater Rochester area.

Our organization is built on the premise that we can change our communities for the better through
partnerships and work together to reduce our reliance on imported oil and improve air quality.

# Our Mission

Greater Rochester Clean Cities is a U.S. Department of Energy designated coalition in the Clean
Cities and Communities partnership. We work  to advance affordable, efficient, and clean
transportation fuels, energy efficient mobility-systems, and other fuel-saving technologies and
practices throughout the Greater Rochester area.

Our organization is built on the premise that we can change our communities for the better through
partnerships and work together to reduce our reliance on imported oil and improve air quality.

# Why Choose KAMA?

Shandong Kama Automobile Manufacturing Co., Ltd. possesses advanced painting, welding, and assembly
lines, achieving an annual production capacity of 200,000 vehicles. The company has successively
passed ISO9001 quality system certification, COC certification, and ISO/TS16949 certification.
* Factory Direct Strength & SKD/CKD Solutions
  Factory Direct Strength & SKD/CKD Solutions
  Genuine manufacturer with full control over production—from chassis to electrical systems. Offer
  SKD/CKD assembly solutions to optimize tariffs, support local manufacturing, and reduce logistics
  costs.
* New Energy Technology & Custom R&D
  New Energy Technology & Custom R&D
  Expertise in EV, CNG dual-fuel, and traditional powertrains with tailored R&D capabilities. Adapt
  designs to local market needs, from battery capacity to vehicle configuration.
* Engineered for Overseas Markets
  Engineered for Overseas Markets
  Reinforced chassis and suspension built to withstand high temperatures, dust, and complex road
  conditions. Full RHD/LHD coverage ensures compliance in Africa, Asia, Middle East, and South
  America.
* End-to-End Quality Control
  End-to-End Quality Control
  Multi-node inspections throughout production, export PDI standards, and fully traceable records.
  Partner with branded component suppliers and conduct rigorous high-temperature testing.
* Global Supply Chain & Delivery Assurance
  Global Supply Chain & Delivery Assurance
  Flexible mixed-line production handles both small and large batches. Mature logistics network and
  standardized export processes ensure on-time delivery worldwide.
* Worldwide Service & Project Experience
  Worldwide Service & Project Experience
  Exporting to 60+ countries with proven success in fleet and government projects. Genuine OEM
  parts, remote technical support, and multi-country certification assistance.

## In Terms of Innovation

Providing global customers with safe, reliable, and cost-effective commercial vehicle and new energy
solutions—platform-based, three-electric core, and intelligent-driven.

### • Commercial Vehicle Platform Technologies

Kama has established modular platform architectures covering micro-trucks, light trucks, and special
purpose vehicles. Through standardized development of chassis, power, electrical, and body systems,
we enable rapid iteration and adaptation across different wheelbases, load capacities, and power
forms.

### • New Energy Vehicle Platform Technologies

Kama focuses on core breakthroughs in electric drive, battery management, and vehicle control
systems, delivering reliable and cost-effective new energy solutions for global markets.

# Why Choose KAMA?

Shandong Kama Automobile Manufacturing Co., Ltd. possesses advanced painting, welding, and assembly
lines, achieving an annual production capacity of 200,000 vehicles. The company has successively
passed ISO9001 quality system certification, COC certification, and ISO/TS16949 certification.
* Factory Direct Strength & SKD/CKD Solutions
  Factory Direct Strength & SKD/CKD Solutions
  Genuine manufacturer with full control over production—from chassis to electrical systems. Offer
  SKD/CKD assembly solutions to optimize tariffs, support local manufacturing, and reduce logistics
  costs.
* New Energy Technology & Custom R&D
  New Energy Technology & Custom R&D
  Expertise in EV, CNG dual-fuel, and traditional powertrains with tailored R&D capabilities. Adapt
  designs to local market needs, from battery capacity to vehicle configuration.
* Engineered for Overseas Markets
  Engineered for Overseas Markets
  Reinforced chassis and suspension built to withstand high temperatures, dust, and complex road
  conditions. Full RHD/LHD coverage ensures compliance in Africa, Asia, Middle East, and South
  America.
* End-to-End Quality Control
  End-to-End Quality Control
  Multi-node inspections throughout production, export PDI standards, and fully traceable records.
  Partner with branded component suppliers and conduct rigorous high-temperature testing.
* Global Supply Chain & Delivery Assurance
  Global Supply Chain & Delivery Assurance
  Flexible mixed-line production handles both small and large batches. Mature logistics network and
  standardized export processes ensure on-time delivery worldwide.
* Worldwide Service & Project Experience
  Worldwide Service & Project Experience
  Exporting to 60+ countries with proven success in fleet and government projects. Genuine OEM
  parts, remote technical support, and multi-country certification assistance.

## In Terms of Innovation

Providing global customers with safe, reliable, and cost-effective commercial vehicle and new energy
solutions—platform-based, three-electric core, and intelligent-driven.

Kama has established modular platform architectures covering micro-trucks, light trucks, and special

we enable rapid iteration and adaptation across different wheelbases, load capacities, and power
forms.

### • New Energy Vehicle Platform Technologies

Kama focuses on core breakthroughs in electric drive, battery management, and vehicle control
systems, delivering reliable and cost-effective new energy solutions for global markets.

Since 1908, LEVC (London EV Company) has been at the forefront of British automotive craftsmanship
and innovation. Renowned for designing the first dedicated black cab for London, our brand has
become a symbol of quality, reliability, and timeless design.

In 2018, we revolutionized urban mobility with the launch of the electric TX—the world's cleanest
and most advanced taxi with groundbreaking eCity, REEV (Range-Extended Electric Vehicle) technology.
This pioneering model reflects our unwavering commitment to innovation and sustainability, helping
cities around the globe transition to greener transport solutions.

As we continue to build on our iconic heritage, LEVC is transforming into a high-volume,
all-electric automotive leader. With a forward-thinking strategy, we are dedicated to creating
smarter, cleaner, safer, and more accessible mobility solutions designed for modern living.

Our mission is to redefine the future of urban transportation—driving progress while reducing
environmental impact. Join us in setting new standards in efficiency, innovation, and excellence.

## THE LONDON EV COMPANY

### LEVC: A Legacy of Innovation and Sustainable Mobility Solutions

Since 1908, LEVC (London EV Company) has been at the forefront of British automotive craftsmanship
and innovation. Renowned for designing the first dedicated black cab for London, our brand has
become a symbol of quality, reliability, and timeless design.

In 2018, we revolutionized urban mobility with the launch of the electric TX—the world's cleanest
and most advanced taxi with groundbreaking eCity, REEV (Range-Extended Electric Vehicle) technology.
This pioneering model reflects our unwavering commitment to innovation and sustainability, helping
cities around the globe transition to greener transport solutions.

As we continue to build on our iconic heritage, LEVC is transforming into a high-volume,
all-electric automotive leader. With a forward-thinking strategy, we are dedicated to creating
smarter, cleaner, safer, and more accessible mobility solutions designed for modern living.

Our mission is to redefine the future of urban transportation—driving progress while reducing
environmental impact. Join us in setting new standards in efficiency, innovation, and excellence.

# Your trusted partner for premium gas storage.

As industry leaders, we deliver reliable and advanced aluminum and composite cylinder solutions
tailored to your needs.

[Contact us][19]

## Aluminum Gas Cylinders

Partner with the pioneers for superior gas storage. Trust our legacy of innovation and expertise for
reliable and high-performance gas cylinders.

[MARKETS][20]

## Composite Gas Cylinders

Your trusted partner for reliable gas storage. As pioneers, we’ve built our reputation on creating
dependable composite gas cylinders that provide peace of mind.

[MARKETS][21]

Luxfer Group is a leading producer of highly engineered advanced materials that help to **protect
lives**, **provide a cleaner environment**, and **make industries more efficient**.

At Luxfer Gas Cylinders, we are pioneers in the engineering and manufacturing of
**gas storage solutions.**

## We manufacture gas cylinders for a variety of applications:

**Type 1** Aluminum Cylinders

**Type 2** Aluminum and Carbon Fiber Hoop-Wrapped Cylinders

**Type 3** Aluminum Liner Carbon Composite Cylinders

**Type 4** Polymer Liner Carbon Composite Cylinders

We also produce **gas storage** and **transportation systems** using our Type 3 or Type 4 cylinders.

[ABOUT][22]

### Why Choose Luxfer Gas Cylinders?

**Revolutionizing Gas Containment for a Safer, Healthier World.**

A Luxfer Group company (NYSE:LXFR), with global manufacturing.

We deliver cutting-edge composite and aluminum cylinders across diverse industries, from aerospace
to alternative fuels, driven by strong innovation and trusted partnerships.

Our wide range of cylinders provide our customers with gas storage solutions for all types of gases,
from non-reactive gases to ultra-high purity and reactive gases.

With over 70 million cylinders in operation worldwide, and supplying major gas companies worldwide –
we’re the global leader in high-pressure gas storage solutions.

## Our Latest Innovative Solutions

## G-Stor® Go Hydrosphere

Redefining sustainable energy storage with our new Multiple Element Gas Container (MEGC).

[Products][23]

## LUXFER CARE

Introducing **LUXFER** CARE, our comprehensive support and maintenance service for Hydrogen and CNG
fuel storage and distribution systems.

[Luxfer Care][24]

## G-Stor® Pro Bundle

Introducing Luxfer Gas Cylinders’ new range of Multiple Cylinder Pallets (MCPs).

[Products][25]

## 70 bar calibration gas cylinder

With a service pressure of 70 bar for efficient storage and utilisation, and a weight of just 0.8kg,
our newest calibration gas cylinder is easy to handle, transport and use.

[Products][26]
[hydrogen-cylinder]

## G-Stor® Go H2

Luxfer’s G-Stor Go H2 products are the newest entry to our line of lightweight high-pressure
hydrogen-storage cylinders.

[Products][27]
[medical-oxygen]

## L7X Medical Oxygen Cylinders

We work closely with medical gas suppliers to ensure our products deliver for those who need them
most.

[Products][28]

## G-Stor® Pro H2

Lightweight high-pressure hydrogen storage cylinders used by a number of the world’s largest OEMs.

[Products][29]

MAHLE Powertrain

MAHLE Powertrain is the technology-agnostic engineering services consultancy that delivers
world-leading powertrain solutions with the agility of motorsport and the rigour and quality of
OEMs.
As a recognised expert in leading-edge research, development and application of advanced drivelines,
control systems and software, MAHLE Powertrain provides complete engineering solutions across all
powertrain technologies - from advanced internal combustion engines and hybrids to cutting-edge
hydrogen and battery electric systems.
Operating independently as the Engineering Services subsidiary of the MAHLE Group, MAHLE Powertrain
has technical centres strategically located in the UK, Germany and China, supporting customers
globally. The company combines 20 years of powertrain innovation with deep expertise in alternative
fuels, including industry-leading hydrogen combustion development.
From concept to validation, MAHLE Powertrain partners with vehicle manufacturers, startups and
technology companies to transform tomorrow's mobility solutions into production-ready realities,
today.

MAHLE Powertrain is fully certified to the latest TISAX standard for the global automotive industry.

TISAX (Trusted Information Security Assessment Exchange) ensures the physical and technical
protection of all sensitive and confidential hardware, infrastructure and information within the
automotive supply chain.

MAHLE Powertrain

MAHLE Powertrain is the technology-agnostic engineering services consultancy that delivers
world-leading powertrain solutions with the agility of motorsport and the rigour and quality of
OEMs.
As a recognised expert in leading-edge research, development and application of advanced drivelines,
control systems and software, MAHLE Powertrain provides complete engineering solutions across all
powertrain technologies - from advanced internal combustion engines and hybrids to cutting-edge
hydrogen and battery electric systems.
Operating independently as the Engineering Services subsidiary of the MAHLE Group, MAHLE Powertrain
has technical centres strategically located in the UK, Germany and China, supporting customers
globally. The company combines 20 years of powertrain innovation with deep expertise in alternative
fuels, including industry-leading hydrogen combustion development.
From concept to validation, MAHLE Powertrain partners with vehicle manufacturers, startups and
technology companies to transform tomorrow's mobility solutions into production-ready realities,
today.

MAHLE Powertrain is fully certified to the latest TISAX standard for the global automotive industry.

TISAX (Trusted Information Security Assessment Exchange) ensures the physical and technical
protection of all sensitive and confidential hardware, infrastructure and information within the
automotive supply chain.

# MIDA GROUP

Shanghai Mida Cable Group Ltd. operates through its wholly owned subsidiaries: Shanghai Mida EV
Power Co., Ltd., Shenzhen Mida EV Power Co., Ltd., and Shanghai Mida New Energy Co., Ltd.

Mida Cable manufactures a comprehensive range of EV charging cables, including 16A–80A J1772 cables,
16A–63A IEC 62196-2 Type 2 cables, and DC fast charging cables: CCS1 (80A–500A), CCS2 (125A–1000A),
CHAdeMO (125A–300A), GBT (200A–1000A), and NACS connectors (250A–600A).

MIDA EV Power produces a full lineup of EV charging stations, such as 7kW–50kW mobile chargers,
3.6kW–7.2kW portable DC chargers, 360kW–1440kW split-type DC fast chargers, 20kW–50kW wall-mounted
DC chargers, and 60kW–480kW floor-standing DC fast charging stations.

MIDA New Energy specializes in EV charger power modules, offering 20kW–60kW standard modules,
40kW–125kW liquid-cooled modules, 30kW–62.5kW bidirectional modules, and 20kW–45kW V2G charging
modules.

# MIDA GROUP

Shanghai Mida Cable Group Ltd. operates through its wholly owned subsidiaries: Shanghai Mida EV
Power Co., Ltd., Shenzhen Mida EV Power Co., Ltd., and Shanghai Mida New Energy Co., Ltd.

Mida Cable manufactures a comprehensive range of EV charging cables, including 16A–80A J1772 cables,
16A–63A IEC 62196-2 Type 2 cables, and DC fast charging cables: CCS1 (80A–500A), CCS2 (125A–1000A),
CHAdeMO (125A–300A), GBT (200A–1000A), and NACS connectors (250A–600A).

MIDA EV Power produces a full lineup of EV charging stations, such as 7kW–50kW mobile chargers,
3.6kW–7.2kW portable DC chargers, 360kW–1440kW split-type DC fast chargers, 20kW–50kW wall-mounted
DC chargers, and 60kW–480kW floor-standing DC fast charging stations.

MIDA New Energy specializes in EV charger power modules, offering 20kW–60kW standard modules,
40kW–125kW liquid-cooled modules, 30kW–62.5kW bidirectional modules, and 20kW–45kW V2G charging
modules.

[mainimg]

**KEEP YOUR FUEL CELL STACK COOL AND CLEAN **

The FC-SCP predicts temperature swings to proactively cool your fuel cell stack with minimum power
draw.
