[LCON_BTMS_3_comp_RND1a]

**REGULATE BATTERY TEMPERATURE IN RUGGED, DIRTY ENVIRONMENTS**

The L-CON BTMS optimizes the temperature range for an entire bank of batteries with a single unit in
all types of environments.

[ Read More ][49]

### [BTMS Air-Cooled Condenser][50]

[Iso_1_RND4 (1)]

**CONTROL YOUR BATTERY’S TEMPERATURE IN ALL ENVIRONMENTS**

With multi-stage cooling and heating, the A-CON BTMS optimizes the temperature range for an entire
bank of batteries with a single unit in all types of environments.

[ Read More ][51]

### [Electronics Cooling Package][52]

[1a0219290000_ISOTop_RND2]

**KEEP YOUR ENGINE’S ELECTRONICS COOL FOR ALL LOADS**

With multi-zone cooling, the ECP is a complete solution to effectively cool down the power
electronics on your electric traction engine while minimizing power draw.

[ Read More ][53]

### Evantage™ thermal management systems are designed, tested and assembled in the USA, built to
### last in harsh environments.

[Rail][55]

With the ports electrifying, sustainable locomotives become a consideration to reduce greenhouse
gases. With the challenges to electrify, the locomotive market is uncovering unique techniques to
develop sustainable locomotives.

[Off-Highway][57]

The electrification of off-highway machinery is on the rise due to the benefits of reduced
emissions, noise and maintenance, uptake, and fuel costs over the lifetime of the vehicles.

Avoid roadside breakdowns and ensure dependable operation of your bus with our efficient, high

Fit the tight space constraints and extended range requirements of your delivery van with our
compact thermal systems

[ Learn More ][62]

Safely deliver your passengers every day with our cost-effective, high reliability thermal systems

Ensure a long life for your truck despite harsh environments and heavy vibration use with our
robust, proven thermal systems

PRESENCE IN EUROPE FOR EVANTAGE PRODUCT LINE
[evantage_under_trans]

#### Every day, we partner with our customers to solve the critical thermal issues created by the
#### transition to Zero Emission Mobility, pushing the boundaries of technology to solve the
#### toughest problems

[ Learn More ][45]

### [Fuel Cell Stack Cooling Package][46]

[mainimg]

**KEEP YOUR FUEL CELL STACK COOL AND CLEAN **

The FC-SCP predicts temperature swings to proactively cool your fuel cell stack with minimum power
draw.

[ Read More ][47]

### [BTMS Liquid-Cooled Condenser][48]

[LCON_BTMS_3_comp_RND1a]

**REGULATE BATTERY TEMPERATURE IN RUGGED, DIRTY ENVIRONMENTS**

The L-CON BTMS optimizes the temperature range for an entire bank of batteries with a single unit in
all types of environments.

[ Read More ][49]

### [BTMS Air-Cooled Condenser][50]

[Iso_1_RND4 (1)]

**CONTROL YOUR BATTERY’S TEMPERATURE IN ALL ENVIRONMENTS**

With multi-stage cooling and heating, the A-CON BTMS optimizes the temperature range for an entire
bank of batteries with a single unit in all types of environments.

[ Read More ][51]

### [Electronics Cooling Package][52]

[1a0219290000_ISOTop_RND2]

**KEEP YOUR ENGINE’S ELECTRONICS COOL FOR ALL LOADS**

With multi-zone cooling, the ECP is a complete solution to effectively cool down the power
electronics on your electric traction engine while minimizing power draw.

[ Read More ][53]

### Evantage™ thermal management systems are designed, tested and assembled in the USA, built to
### last in harsh environments.

## [IDEAL FOR ANY CHASSIS][54]

[Rail][55]

With the ports electrifying, sustainable locomotives become a consideration to reduce greenhouse
gases. With the challenges to electrify, the locomotive market is uncovering unique techniques to
develop sustainable locomotives.

[ Learn More ][56]
[Off-Highway][57]

The electrification of off-highway machinery is on the rise due to the benefits of reduced
emissions, noise and maintenance, uptake, and fuel costs over the lifetime of the vehicles.

[ Learn More ][58]
[Transit and Coach Bus][59]

Avoid roadside breakdowns and ensure dependable operation of your bus with our efficient, high
reliability thermal systems

[ Learn More ][60]
[Last Mile Delivery Van][61]

Fit the tight space constraints and extended range requirements of your delivery van with our
compact thermal systems

[ Learn More ][62]
[School Bus][63]

Safely deliver your passengers every day with our cost-effective, high reliability thermal systems

[ Learn More ][64]
[Truck][65]

Ensure a long life for your truck despite harsh environments and heavy vibration use with our
robust, proven thermal systems

[ Learn More ][66]

#### Join the Modine EVantage community to stay in touch and get the latest news!

Leave this field empty if you're human:

[reverse modine logo]

**LEADING THERMAL MANAGEMENT SINCE 1916**

We design, manufacture, and test heat transfer products for a wide variety of applications and
markets. We’re at work in practically every corner of the world, delivering the solutions our
customers need, where they need them.

# Accelerate your
# 
# PDF workflow
# 
# like never before

Create, edit, convert, compress and secure your PDF documents FASTER with PDF Agile.

Free Download[Buy Now][47]

Available on:

## Edit PDF like a Pro

Quickly and easily update your own PDF documents. Works like a word processor-reflow text across
paragraphs, columns, and pages; change document layout, modify text size, font, or line spacing, and
add multimedia.

[feature-edit.png]

## **Convert**** from and to PDF without losing formatting**

Easily convert PDF files to Word, Excel, PowerPoint, TXT, images, and CAD and vice versa while
retaining the original formatting.

[feature-convert.png]

## **Organize PDF**
## 
## ** ****with ease**

Organize and manipulate PDF pages to support your workflows. Merge and split documents; drag and
drop pages within a file or from one document to another; and add stamps, watermarks, headers,
footers, and more.

[feature-organize.png]

## **Powerful OCR**
## 
## **engine integrated**

Extract text from any images or scanned PDF documents with our powerful full-text Optical Character
Recognition (OCR) feature.

[feature-ocr.png]

## **Enhance your digital **
## 
## **reading experience**

Three different modes for all scenarios. Switch between Read Mode, Full-Screen Mode, and Slideshow
with just the touch of the button.

[feature-read.png]

## A complete PDF solution for all PDF needs

### Education

Students, teachers, parents can all take notes, annotate parts within PDFs. Turn your PDF documents
into visually stunning presentations.

### Publishing

Scale efficiency for publishers. You can easily combine, organize, split, and delete pages to get
books ready for review and printing.

### IT & Engineer

Fast file conversion maximizes productivity. Quickly create high-quality technical documents from
Word, Excel, and others.

### Legal & Government

Protect your PDF file with a password. Redact text or images to hide confidential information.

### Finance

Go paperless and save time with fully digital workflows. Securely sign PDF documents in a faster
way.

Through our family of drivers, dispatchers, mechanics, and managers, Student Transportation of
America provides uncompromising transportation services to our communities and their families.

#### Vehicles operated

#### Districts served

#### Contract Renewal Rate

The key to our strength is our family of companies – local operators who know your local community,
backed by the support of STA’s national network. We are committed to providing dependable,
professional, and environmentally-conscious transportation that supports the well-being of our
passengers and their families.

[More About STA][29]
[Safety First, Last, and Always]

## Safety First, Last, and Always

Nothing is more important than the safety of our children and at STA, our #1 priority is ensuring
reliable transportation through our innovative training programs and ongoing quality assurance
system of standards.

[Learn More][30]
[Join the STA Team]

## Join the STA Team

What makes STA truly unique is our culture of fostering environments that support the students we
transport — and each other. We invite you to explore our job opportunities in communities all across
North America, and invest in your future through a rewarding career with STA!

[View our job openings][31]

## Reach out to STA today!

We’d love to talk with you! Contact us to hear from one of our team members.

## The VinFast Experience

VinFast, the innovative new electric car company, prioritizes premium craftsmanship and innovation
in engineering it’s EVs.  Driving VinFast electric vehicles gives you the opportunity for savings
benefits versus a gas vehicle and the peace of mind that comes with an industry-leading warranty.

[World-class warranty]

### World-class warranty

VinFast proudly offers an impressive 10-Year/125,000-Mile New Vehicle Limited Warranty and
10-Year/Unlimited Miles Battery Warranty under standard use. This excellent and transferable
warranty coverage, offers a decade of peace of mind for drivers regardless of where their journeys
may take them.
 

[Explore Warranty][31]

[Hassle-free charging]

### Hassle-free charging

Whether embarking on daily commutes or longer road trips, VinFast simplifies public charging with
access to 95% of public charging stations nationwide and over 250,000 chargers across North America.
Charging options include Level 2 AC Charging and Level 3 DC Fast Charging which gets you 10-70%
charge in just 31 minutes.

[Explore Charging][32]

[The all-in-one VinFast App]

### The all-in-one VinFast App

The VinFast App serves as a comprehensive hub for all maintenance and charging needs. From 24/7⁵
flexible maintenance and support to trip planning tools, remote charging management, and in-app
payment, it's a one-stop solution designed to enhance convenience and accessibility for every
driver.
 

[VinFast App T&C][33]

[Energy Savings]

### Energy Savings

An Electric Vehicle can save 50% or more a year over gas vehicle fueling costs^{1,2 }. The cost of
daily energy usage on an electric vehicle is influenced by a lot of factors, including whether you
charge at home or use a public charger, the price of electricity, your driving characteristics, and
the efficiency of your electric car.  The fuel savings with an electric car can be immense. On
average, US EV drivers can save 7.4 cents per mile compared to those driving gas-powered vehicles
which translates to about $90/month for 1,200 miles (around the US average), or nearly $1,100 a
year³

[Maintenance Cost Savings]

### Maintenance Cost Savings

An Electric Vehicle can save 40% or more in maintenance costs over a 15-year standard ownership
period⁴. EVs can be less expensive to maintain over the vehicle’s lifetime since EVs have fewer
moving parts than those with a gas engine and do not require fluid (oil, transmission, etc.) or
engine parts (timing belt, oxygen sensors, spark plugs, etc.) changes. The US Department of Energy
study concluded that an EV costs 6.1 cents per mile, while a gas engine vehicle costs 10.1 cents per
mile.  EVs still require basic maintenance such as tire and brake replacements⁴

[Prioritizing Customer Service]

### Prioritizing Customer Service

At VinFast we pride ourselves on the support we give to our customers. Our customers believe in our
brand and our team members work tirelessly to make the experience owning a VinFast product as simple
as possible from service, support and maintenance. Our goal is to make sure your VinFast vehicle is
always kept up-to-date with the latest software updates and that we work each day to earn your
business.

VinFast, the innovative new electric car company, prioritizes premium craftsmanship and innovation

[World-class warranty]

### World-class warranty

VinFast proudly offers an impressive 10-Year/125,000-Mile New Vehicle Limited Warranty and
10-Year/Unlimited Miles Battery Warranty under standard use. This excellent and transferable
warranty coverage, offers a decade of peace of mind for drivers regardless of where their journeys

[Hassle-free charging]

### Hassle-free charging

Whether embarking on daily commutes or longer road trips, VinFast simplifies public charging with
access to 95% of public charging stations nationwide and over 250,000 chargers across North America.
Charging options include Level 2 AC Charging and Level 3 DC Fast Charging which gets you 10-70%
charge in just 31 minutes.

[Explore Charging][32]

[The all-in-one VinFast App]

### The all-in-one VinFast App

The VinFast App serves as a comprehensive hub for all maintenance and charging needs. From 24/7⁵
flexible maintenance and support to trip planning tools, remote charging management, and in-app
payment, it's a one-stop solution designed to enhance convenience and accessibility for every
driver.
 

[VinFast App T&C][33]

[Energy Savings]

### Energy Savings

An Electric Vehicle can save 50% or more a year over gas vehicle fueling costs^{1,2 }. The cost of
daily energy usage on an electric vehicle is influenced by a lot of factors, including whether you
charge at home or use a public charger, the price of electricity, your driving characteristics, and
the efficiency of your electric car.  The fuel savings with an electric car can be immense. On
average, US EV drivers can save 7.4 cents per mile compared to those driving gas-powered vehicles
which translates to about $90/month for 1,200 miles (around the US average), or nearly $1,100 a
year³

[Maintenance Cost Savings]

### Maintenance Cost Savings

An Electric Vehicle can save 40% or more in maintenance costs over a 15-year standard ownership
period⁴. EVs can be less expensive to maintain over the vehicle’s lifetime since EVs have fewer
moving parts than those with a gas engine and do not require fluid (oil, transmission, etc.) or
engine parts (timing belt, oxygen sensors, spark plugs, etc.) changes. The US Department of Energy
study concluded that an EV costs 6.1 cents per mile, while a gas engine vehicle costs 10.1 cents per
mile.  EVs still require basic maintenance such as tire and brake replacements⁴

[Prioritizing Customer Service]

### Prioritizing Customer Service

At VinFast we pride ourselves on the support we give to our customers. Our customers believe in our
brand and our team members work tirelessly to make the experience owning a VinFast product as simple
as possible from service, support and maintenance. Our goal is to make sure your VinFast vehicle is
always kept up-to-date with the latest software updates and that we work each day to earn your
business.

  Matco Tools manufactures, distributes, and services professional automotive repair and maintenance
  tools, storage, and equipment. Since 1979, it has sold its products to professional mechanics and

What makes us different

### Working together as Team Vontier

These different businesses make up Vontier, but we’re all part of one team. This means we can
partner with our customers to help them solve their high-value problems through our deep domain
expertise. As their companies grow and the market changes, we bring in experts from across our
businesses to support them. This includes developing customized solutions drawing on different
features of our products and services.

### Navigating complexity

Our decades of experience across our businesses give us unmatched expertise and a deep understanding
of the three key customer segments we support. We use this understanding to provide clear insights
about market trends and technological developments. This allows us to help our customers keep their
businesses prepared for the future and focused on the opportunities ahead.

### Connecting better

With an extensive portfolio of mobility technology systems, connected hardware and software, we can
meet our customers where they are in the multi-energy journey and provide them with full support to
make progress. This covers everything from planning to set up to ongoing use, so they can invest and
transform with confidence. Plus, our size and scale gives us the ability to invest in R&D so we can
pioneer innovation and keep our customers out in front.

including EV, CNG and RNG – and repair tools to car-wash technology.

* [ANGI Energy logo]
  [Close Modal]
  [ANGI Energy logo]
  
  Delivering next-generation alternative fueling platforms for a sustainable future.
  
  Fleet solutions
  
  Founded in 1983, ANGI designs and manufactures end-to-end systems for the refilling of alternative
  fuel vehicles, including compressed natural gas (CNG), renewable natural gas (RNG or biomethane),
  and hydrogen. It has supplied over two thousand CNG and RNG stations to date and has a
  long-standing reputation as a leader in high-pressure compression and refueling. Its customers
  look to it for reliable and innovative full-site solutions and services to meet their changing
  energy needs. ANGI is now driving the transformation of Vontier’s traditional-fuel business into a
  multi-energy platform ready to support their customers on their decarbonization journey.
* [DRB]
  [Close Modal]
  [DRB]
  
  Powering forward-looking car washes with tech-enabled controls and consumer intelligence.
  
  Convenience retail
  
  With over 40 years as the leading car wash technology provider, DRB® empowers operators to run and
  grow great businesses through fast, reliable, and engaging solutions. Its advanced point-of-sale
  systems, marketing automation, data-driven tools, and real-time tunnel performance insights help
  maximize ROI, boost membership growth, and deliver exceptional customer experiences - all backed
  by a commitment to innovation, quality, and support.
* [Driivz]
  [Close Modal]
  [Driivz]
  
  Smarter EV charging and energy management
  
  Convenience retail
  
  Established in 2013, Driivz powers the e-mobility revolution with a market-leading, end-to-end EV
  charging and energy management platform.
  
  We enable global charge point operators and electric vehicle service providers to accelerate their
  market leadership by building a scalable infrastructure and delivering an exceptional charging
  experience, while optimizing operations, reducing TCO, speeding time-to-market and maximizing
  revenues
* [Gilbarco]
  [Close Modal]
  [Gilbarco]
  
  Fueling the future of transportation with advanced equipment and technology.
  
  Convenience retail
  
  Whenever you fuel up or grab convenience store snacks, you’re likely to touch the technology of
  Gilbarco Veeder-Root, the global leader for integrated retail and commercial fueling solutions.
  From low-emissions dispensers to fuel management solutions, Gilbarco Veeder-Root keeps the world
  moving. 
  
  For more than 150 years, Gilbarco Veeder-Root has earned customer trust through reliable equipment
  and support, and forward-looking innovations. Gilbarco Veeder-Root is now mobilizing the future by
  addressing changing energy grid and transportation needs through ultrafast EV chargers,
  alternative fuels, emissions testing technology, and powerful analytics. 
  
  With a worldwide presence and enduring partnerships with global brands like 7-Eleven, Shell, and
  Exxon-Mobil, Gilbarco Veeder-Root is paving the way to the future of mobility.
* [Invenco]
  [Close Modal]
  [Invenco]
  
  Redefining convenience, together.
  
  Convenience retail
  
  Invenco was created to help our customers adapt and innovate to stay ahead. Whatever form the
  future takes, Invenco will be the operating system for convenience retail, producing agile
  solutions for accelerated growth and value. 
  
  Invenco is proud to offer industry leading point-of-sale systems, payment solutions, site
  automations, workflows, and cloud services. With products and solutions offered by Invenco,
  customers like Shell, ExxonMobil, and Chevron can easily introduce new customer features such as:
  managing changes, navigating regulations, managing sites and assets remotely, and scaling
  operations rapidly.
* [Matco Tools]
  [Close Modal]
  [Matco Tools]
  
  Keeping vehicles in motion with trusted automotive repair and diagnostic tools.
  
  Auto-repair
  
  Matco Tools manufactures, distributes, and services professional automotive repair and maintenance
  tools, storage, and equipment. Since 1979, it has sold its products to professional mechanics and
  enthusiasts through its network of over 1,800 franchisees, who operate in all 50 US states, as
  well as Canada, and Puerto Rico. Its focus is on equipping its customers with the tools they need
  to build their futures and keep tomorrow’s vehicles in motion. These range from software-enabled
  workflows to advanced diagnostic tools. 

What makes us different

### Working together as Team Vontier

These different businesses make up Vontier, but we’re all part of one team. This means we can
partner with our customers to help them solve their high-value problems through our deep domain
expertise. As their companies grow and the market changes, we bring in experts from across our
businesses to support them. This includes developing customized solutions drawing on different
features of our products and services.

### Navigating complexity

Our decades of experience across our businesses give us unmatched expertise and a deep understanding
of the three key customer segments we support. We use this understanding to provide clear insights
about market trends and technological developments. This allows us to help our customers keep their
businesses prepared for the future and focused on the opportunities ahead.

### Connecting better

With an extensive portfolio of mobility technology systems, connected hardware and software, we can
meet our customers where they are in the multi-energy journey and provide them with full support to
make progress. This covers everything from planning to set up to ongoing use, so they can invest and
transform with confidence. Plus, our size and scale gives us the ability to invest in R&D so we can
pioneer innovation and keep our customers out in front.

cleaner alternative fuel solutions and are built for peak performance.

climate change and urban air quality challenges while maintaining performance for heavier duty and
high horsepower commercial mobility and industrial applications. **We deliver now and into the
future**.

# Westport Fuel Systems

## The global leader in alternative fuel solutions

## Innovative, high-quality solutions that meet strict emission standards.

Our global team develops and supplies advanced LPG, CNG, LNG, and H2 systems and components for OEM,
DOEM, and AM sectors worldwide. Our main customers operate in the automotive sector, but also in
transportation, off-road vehicles, electronics, alternative fuel storage, and motor racing. They
test innovative, high-quality solutions that meet strict emission standards.

About WORLINK

## Your Trusted Partner for
## Chinese Automotive Excellence

Founded in 1999, WORLINK AUTO has grown into one of China's most trusted automotive distribution
groups. The company holds authorized distribution rights for **12 traditional fuel vehicle brands
and new energy vehicle brands**, selling more than **8,000 vehicles annually**.

Our authorized brand portfolio spans the full spectrum of the automotive market — from high-end
luxury models to accessible everyday vehicles — covering passenger cars, commercial vehicles, new
energy vehicles, SUVs, and MPVs.

The group's holding company, **Tianjin WORLINK International Trade Co., Ltd.**, has received the
Ministry of Commerce's official qualification for second-hand car export enterprises, with monthly
car exports reaching 300 units. By 2024, the company is projected to achieve an export volume of
3,000 vehicles with a turnover of 1.5 billion yuan.
